images.description: A modern, circular building with distinctive ring-shaped architectural features sits amidst a well-maintained green lawn, with tall skyscrapers in the background under a bright blue sky.
A courtyard with tiered rock gardens, water features, small trees, and a surrounding modern geometric building with intricate facade details.
The architecture of the Shanghai Museum features a futuristic, circular design with a large, domed roof and a prominent spherical structure, surrounded by well-maintained green spaces and pathways.
A modern, circular building with a green rooftop surrounded by lush gardens and trees, featuring large archways and glass windows, characteristic of the Shanghai Museum's architecture exterior.

The exterior of the Shanghai Museum of Glass features a modern glass entrance with signage displaying both Chinese and English text, set against a large, dark, illuminated wall decorated with numerous words related to glass and scientific concepts.
